metadata.title: AI Video Generator – Multi-Model Studio for Text, Image and Clip Inputs
metadata.description: Banana Pro brings Veo 3, Sora 2 Pro, Kling and Wan Pro into a single AI video studio. Turn a written scene, a still photo or an existing clip into a polished short video in just a few minutes.

page.title: Multi-Model AI Video Generator
page.description: Animate any idea you can describe, photograph or record. Pick a generation mode, drop in your prompt or reference, and our orchestrator routes the job to the strongest video model for the task — no editing software required.

faq.title: AI Video Generator – Things People Often Ask

items.question: Which generation modes are available?
items.answer: Three modes ship out of the box. Text-to-Video composes a clip from a written scene, Image-to-Video animates a still you upload, and Video-to-Video remixes an existing clip when you paste its URL.

items.question: How long can a generated clip be?
items.answer: Clips usually land between 5 and 10 seconds, with the exact upper bound depending on the model you pick. A few models also let you trade duration for resolution if you need extra room.

items.question: What resolutions and aspect ratios can I get?
items.answer: Output capabilities vary by model, but you can typically choose between 720p and 1080p, and switch between 16:9 cinematic, 9:16 vertical or 1:1 social-friendly framing.

items.question: How long does a single render take?
items.answer: Most generations finish in 1–5 minutes. Heavier models, longer durations and busy traffic can push that higher; the page shows live progress so you don't have to refresh.

items.question: How are credits charged?
items.answer: Credit cost depends on the chosen mode, model and output length. The estimate is shown on the generator before you confirm, and only successful renders are billed.

items.question: Are the videos safe to use commercially?
items.answer: Yes, within the limits of our Terms of Service and the underlying model's own usage policy. Always re-check the policy of the specific model you used before shipping a paid campaign.
